name: project-advisor
description: Project planning skills for recommending what to build next, writing specs, and turning approved specs into Jira-ready work items or coding-agent task files.

interface.shortDescription: Product planning and spec workflow skills.
interface.longDescription: Packages a project-advice workflow that moves from identifying the best next product bet to writing a spec and slicing it into Jira-ready work items or autonomous coding-agent tasks.
defaultPrompt: Use the next-thing skill to recommend the best next improvement for this repo.
Help me write a spec for this feature idea using the to-spec skill.
Break this spec into Jira-ready vertical slices with the to-issues skill.
Turn this accepted spec.yaml into self-contained implementation tasks with the to-agent-tasks skill.
